overlay.task:
E43 first user value path replay
Prepare the fastest credible path toward one real external user successfully installing and understanding Y*gov / gov-mcp / Y*Bridge Labs' agent-company runtime value.

route_selection.technical_substrate: gov-mcp + Y-star-gov governed execution in 5 minutes
route_selection.why: E43 selected the correct substrate; E44A adds strategic imagination, customer empathy, commercial/evidence screens, and high-imagination preservation.

stages.decision_effect: Require customer-understandable value object plus local technical proof.
stages.reasoning_summary: Task is not just an install-doc check; it asks for the fastest credible first-user value path.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Adds CEO interpretation instead of accepting the router's first repo match.

stages.decision_effect: Reuse existing path assets instead of rebuilding install/demo discovery.
stages.reasoning_summary: E42 resource routing remains useful for finding gov-mcp, Y-star-gov, E43 proof assets, and tests.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Keeps E42 strengths but stops there only for non-strategic tasks.

stages.decision_effect: Forces E35/E36/E39/E41/E42/E43 to participate in route selection.
stages.reasoning_summary: Registry activates earlier cognition as lenses, not as passive files.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Turns dormant artifacts into explicit task-time stages.

stages.decision_effect: Elevates story from CLI install to governed agent action proof.
stages.reasoning_summary: First user path should demonstrate agent-company governance value, not merely package installation.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Adds imagination and strategic framing missing from E43.

stages.decision_effect: Creates a value wrapper around existing technical substrate.
stages.reasoning_summary: Recombine gov-mcp install, Y-star-gov check/enforce, Bridge Labs dogfood, and audit-envelope language into one proof packet.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Converts separate repo docs into a coherent first-user artifact.

stages.decision_effect: Route remains feasible but becomes more CEO-complete.
stages.reasoning_summary: Logical: install/check path must work. Innovation: proof packet differentiates. Strategic: first user sees value fast. Systems: repos retain boundaries. Human: user understands why. Execution: local proof remains feasible.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Adds six-lens reasoning rather than one install criterion.

stages.decision_effect: Keep high-imagination options as future layers, not first blocker.
stages.reasoning_summary: Compare install trial against agent labor proof, board packet, non-human workforce registry, AI work notary, and broader agent-company opportunities.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Prevents gov-mcp install from being mistaken for final product route.

stages.decision_effect: Require the first user packet to show a specific governed-action before/after and do-not-claim list.
stages.reasoning_summary: CFO rejects vague platform claims; product/customer lens rejects raw install docs as too technical; governance reviewer demands boundary clarity.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Adds skepticism and customer empathy missing from old E43.

stages.decision_effect: No customer validation or paid signal; ask owner to approve local demo polish before outreach.
stages.reasoning_summary: Budget signal is not proven. The credible near-term persona is an AI engineer/operator managing file/tool-touching agents.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Keeps commercial discipline instead of only technical readiness.

stages.decision_effect: Downgrade all buyer-demand claims to hypotheses.
stages.reasoning_summary: E38/E39 evidence supports enterprise/governance pain but does not prove demand for Y*. Evidence burden remains first-user comprehension and local proof quality.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Adds evidence burden and no-overclaim discipline.

stages.decision_effect: Do not discard high-imagination path; stage it behind local proof.
stages.reasoning_summary: Preserve Agent Labor Proof Passport, Board Packet for Agentic Operations, Non-Human Workforce Registry, and AI Work Authenticity Notary as future value objects.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Avoids narrowing the company to package install.

stages.decision_effect: No duplicate kernel, MCP layer, CIEU ledger, brain, or KG.
stages.reasoning_summary: Bridge Labs owns packet/demo story; gov-mcp owns execution boundary; Y-star-gov owns governance kernel; K9Audit remains add-on audit layer.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Keeps execution boundaries without suppressing strategic route thinking.

stages.decision_effect: New modules are justified because no task-time cognition cascade existed.
stages.reasoning_summary: Existing E43 runner and selected path are reused; E44A adds cognition runtime and replay comparator as the minimum correction.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: No report-only loop; adds callable runtime.

stages.decision_effect: Route improved rather than fully changed.
stages.reasoning_summary: Selected route stays gov-mcp + Y-star-gov as the technical proof substrate, but user-facing value becomes a Governed Agent Action Proof Packet.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Distinguishes technical substrate from user-facing value object.

stages.decision_effect: Owner decides whether to proceed to local demo polish, not external contact yet.
stages.reasoning_summary: Next action is E45: run activated CEO loop on the real local first-value demo, fix must-fix demo/docs blockers, then prepare owner-approved first external user attempt.
stages.what_changed_from_resource_router_only: Turns replay into an executable next milestone.
